Si-Li-Ka's stream takes a wild turn as the Slime Suit reaches its absolute breaking point under the viewers' demands! With the "I'll Do Whatever You Say!" event in full swing, her body is pushed to incredible new extremes. But when the event ends, she faces a desperate and hilarious struggle to hide her permanent new "surprises" in public. Can a simple universal maid costume contain the chaotic results of her streams? ⚡
